description: Angular component for trip animation widget, handling map visualization, data interpolation, and tooltip rendering within the Thingsboard platform.

classes.name: TripAnimationComponent
classes.description: Angular component implementing trip animation with map visualization, data interpolation, and tooltip management.

methods.name: ngOnInit
methods.description: Initializes widget configuration, subscribes to data updates, and loads necessary functions.

methods.name: ngAfterViewInit
methods.description: Loads map widget after view initialization and sets up resize observer.

methods.name: ngOnDestroy
methods.description: Cleans up resize observer on component destruction.

methods.name: timeUpdated
methods.description: Updates current position data based on the specified time, interpolating if necessary.

methods.name: initializeFunctions
methods.description: Asynchronously parses user-defined functions for point, tooltip, label, and color point.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Processes new data, calculates intervals, and updates map visualization.

methods.name: latestDataUpdate
methods.description: Updates latest data and triggers current data update.

methods.name: updateMapWidget
methods.description: Invalidates and refreshes the map widget display.

methods.name: updateCurrentData
methods.description: Merges current and latest data, updates labels, tooltips, and map points.

methods.name: calculateLastPoints
methods.description: Finds the last valid data point before or at a given time.

methods.name: calculateIntervals
methods.description: Calculates min/max times and interpolates data points for animation.

methods.name: calcTooltip
methods.description: Generates tooltip text for a data point.

methods.name: calcMainTooltip
methods.description: Generates main tooltips for all points.

methods.name: calcLabel
methods.description: Calculates and sets the label HTML for the active trip.

methods.name: interpolateArray
methods.description: Interpolates data points over time for smooth animation.

methods.name: calculateCurrentTime
methods.description: Determines the current animation time based on min/max and normalization step.

methods.name: clearIncorrectFirsLastDatapoint
methods.description: Removes invalid initial or final data points lacking coordinates.

methods.name: findFirstHistoricalDataIndexCoordinate
methods.description: Checks if a data point has valid latitude and longitude.
